entries.capability: Compare the official A2A TCK baseline with the extension enabled
entries.result: Paired TCK runs passed 79 tests each with identical outcomes; protected handlers were not invoked.
entries.limits: Draft, unmerged implementation. Each run skipped 156 tests and deselected 30. This is bounded interoperability evidence, not full TCK conformance or live deployment acceptance.

entries.capability: Persist witness publication intent and fail closed on journal recovery errors
entries.result: The 413-test suite passed, including seven new durable-journal regression tests.
entries.limits: Draft, unmerged implementation. No live witness deployment or automated retry reconciliation is demonstrated; witness policy remains an operator decision.

entries.capability: Exercise Python and TypeScript exporters through a real OpenTelemetry Collector
entries.result: Twenty synthetic Collector cases and six observer controls passed, including saturation, in-flight restart and reversed input timestamps.
entries.limits: Draft, unmerged implementation. Loopback inputs and backend are synthetic; saturation deliberately observes loss and the queue is in memory. Backend deduplication does not prove exactly-once delivery or durable queue replay. Concurrent HTTP arrival order is not guaranteed.
